news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation (NASDAQ:FTAI) Trading 14.6% Higher
news_items.summary: Stock traded up 14.6% on Wednesday, reaching highs of $281.74 amid continued post-Q1 momentum and follow-through buying after the credit facility expansion and dividend hike.

news_items.headline: FTAI Q1 CY2026 Deep Dive: Market Share Expansion and Power Platform Progress Drive Outlook
news_items.summary: Q1 deep-dive coverage highlights aerospace market share expansion and progress on the FTAI Power platform (converting retired CFM56 engines into gas turbines for AI data centers) as the primary outlook drivers.

news_items.headline: MRO Memo: FTAI Reports Little Pressure On Current-Gen Fleets
news_items.summary: Aviation Week reports FTAI sees little maintenance pressure on current-generation fleets, supporting steady CFM56 module demand. 270 modules serviced in Q1, nearly double prior-year volume; Lisbon and Rome facilities still ramping.

news_items.headline: Earnings Miss: FTAI Aviation Missed EPS By 15% And Analysts Are Revising Forecasts
news_items.summary: Statutory Q1 EPS came in at $1.29, 15% short of analyst expectations despite revenue beating by 13% to $831M. Analysts are now revising their forecasts post-print.

news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation Net Margin Breakout Reinforces Bullish Earnings Narrative
news_items.summary: Net margin expansion in Q1 reinforces the bullish long-term narrative; aerospace revenue +104% YoY to $743.8M with Aerospace Products revenue and EBITDA more than doubling.

news_items.headline: FTAI Lifts Dividend Again After Aerospace Revenue Rose 104% to $743.8M
news_items.summary: Quarterly dividend raised to $0.45/share (third consecutive increase), record May 13, paid May 26. Backed by strong free cash flow; revolving credit facility extended with commitments raised to ~$2.025B.

news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation Stock Jumps As Q1 Earnings Power Higher
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 print: net income $134.2M, basic EPS $1.31, revenue $830.7M (+13% beat), Adj EBITDA $325.6M. Stock jumped on aerospace momentum and dividend increase.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: No analyst rating changes specifically surfaced in last 7 days; analysts are actively revising forecasts after the Q1 EPS miss (Simply Wall St, 2026-05-04). Recent prior activity: Barclays high PT $350 issued 2026-02-27; Morgan Stanley raised PT to $293 from $266 on 2026-03-24. Consensus is Strong Buy from 10 analysts (10 buy / 0 hold / 0 sell).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported ~2026-04-30 (revenue beat, EPS miss). Next quarterly print expected early August 2026 (no firm date confirmed in search). Key forward catalysts: FTAI Power platform commercialization (retired CFM56 engines to gas turbines for AI data centers), Jereh Group JV on Mod-1 CFM56 aeroderivative production, ramp of Lisbon and Rome MRO facilities, continued engine program uptake. Long-term street narrative targets $5.7B revenue / $1.6B earnings by 2029.
